review_scope: Four S120/S150 local Cause scopes selected from the unseen-fault-code/no exact-or-partial causes_text overlap stratum. Decisions apply only to the cited local scope, not automatically to other levels of a complete fault tree.
decision_policy: Assign AND/OR only when the exact local text directly defines the same-scope child relation and the child set is complete. Preserve nested relations. Lists, diagnostic values, ordinary conjunctions, effects, and remedies do not establish gates. This pilot does not infer event probabilities or calibration thresholds.

scope_anchor.quote:
The end of the DC link precharging was not able to be completed for one of the following reasons:
1) There is no line voltage connected.
2) The line contactor/line side switch has not been closed.
3) The line voltage is too low.
4) Line voltage incorrectly set (p0210).
5) The precharging resistors are overheated as there were too many precharging operations per time unit.
6) The precharging resistors are overheated as the DC link capacitance is too high.
7) The precharging resistors are overheated because when there is no "ready for operation" (r0863.0) of the infeed 
unit, power is taken from the DC link.
8) The precharging resistors are overheated as the line contactor was closed during the DC link fast discharge 
through the Braking Module.
9) The DC link has either a ground fault or a short-circuit.
10) The precharging circuit is possibly defective (only for chassis units).
